decisions.reason: As a flagship organic salami line with several variants that remained on the website across both years, it fits the firm's core curing and slicing know-how and gives management a strong basis to learn and refine rather than withdraw.

This premium salami snack line still appears in 2024 and is close to the firm's established salami expertise, but its reduced prominence versus launch suggests a somewhat higher chance of rationalisation if demand stays only moderate.

Organic boiled pork sausage is very near the firm's traditional sausage capabilities and current strategic push into organic products, so the firm is likely to keep it while using early market feedback to optimise the offer.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast extends existing sliced cold-cut competencies into a relevant organic poultry niche, and the multiple variants indicate enough commitment and learning potential to justify continuation.

An organic herb-coated salami sits squarely within the firm's seasoning and salami knowledge base, though as a newer and more differentiated variant it carries a modestly higher risk if repeat purchase proves weaker than expected.
